evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are commonly pretrained on large collections of procedurally generated synthetic tasks, yet it remains unclear how well these synthetic pretraining priors support the downstream tasks on which the models are evaluated.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We recover or reconstruct the synthetic data generators of four TFMs and compare their generated tasks with datasets from two widely used tabular benchmarks.
